name: Akane
source: Older sister of the twins and half of Second Sword who controls Wind. With tremendous fighting power and intense hunger for battle, along with her younger sister, they are the Kanto's last resort against Tekki. In contrast to her usual self that doesn't care or pay attention to anything, she becomes extremely sharp when fighting against strong enemy. She acts as the head to make strategies and guide her sister who is more focused on offensive power in combat.
